notes.claim_list: R code is embedded in the deposited WaterGame_RcodeResults_V2.pdf. Scope begins with the supplied coded utterance data.
notes.sol: Lossless extraction of the embedded R code is allowed by the settled design. The source reports one transcription detail about rounds 7–8 that does not change the results. Use its original-R reproduction; the Stata implementation and aggregation/model-selection changes are excluded. The sign of the social-comparison coefficient depends on coding, so the selected target is the invariant test statistic and its SE.
notes.claude: Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes.claude_blind_original_historical: Do not use the Stata values in the report's Tables 2-4 (e.g. 18.719, 19.014, 10.793) as recomputed references: they are Wald joint tests on marginal effects from the replicators' independent Stata reproduction and robustness checks, not the paper's LR tests. Code ships only inside a PDF (code_format 'embedded'); the replicators transcribed it ('the conversion is a substantial amount of work') and fixed one omission on PDF p. 36 (rounds 7 and 8 need adding) that 'does not appear to affect any results' (P3). Their transcribed code is at https://osf.io/4zhuq. Report rates the package as only partially providing raw data and cleaning code (conversation transcripts on request); claims begin from the coded utterance data, so this is in scope. For C1, C4 and C5 the label relies on the report's blanket statement plus the authors' rendered output, hence medium confidence; the paper sign convention for C2 (Est = 0.24) differs from the report's −0.243 (reference level), which does not affect C2/C3. Robustness findings (Result 1 sensitive) ignored.
